existing_tests.coverage: Native launch fixtures execute selected launcher/path/metadata functions and UI in mGBA but mock save/storage and boot/page effects. Separately, source-built DE, Original OMEGA, and BLUE mGBA runs reach PocketNES/Snail Maze through distinct synthetic SD, PSRAM, and source-specific S71/S98 NOR models. SuperCard source-shaped runners cover all three board/kernel/storage paths; Chis also has an end-to-end PocketNES control result. All are software-model results, not physical-card qualification.

ezflash_source_audit.sd_gba_bus_transcript: All three pinned DSSMM lanes write command unlock values at 0x09FE0000/0x08000000/0x08020000/0x08040000, sector address/count at 0x09600000/0x09620000/0x09640000, command end at 0x09FC0000; control is 0x09400000, status/data aperture is 0x09E00000, DMA transfers data in groups up to four 512-byte sectors; writes set bit 15 in count
ezflash_source_audit.shared_kernel_memory_windows: Source declares PSRAM aperture 0x08800000, S98 flash window 0x09000000, S71 NOR base 0x08000000, and save SRAM 0x0E000000; physical mapping and behavior UNVERIFIED
ezflash_source_audit.lane_differences: Original OMEGA performs plugin copy/decompression in C after common page selection; OMEGA DE uses DE_BootHandoff assembly; BLUE adds OS/game mode bit and Blue_PrepareFlashAccess and uses Blue_BootHandoff assembly
ezflash_source_audit.fixture_boundary: Five-case native launch tests per lane exercise launcher/path/metadata to a fixture handoff marker; card bus, physical SD, PSRAM/NOR/SRAM and save effects are mocked or outside fixture scope
ezflash_source_audit.hardware_status: UNVERIFIED: physical register decode, waitstates, response values/timing, SD media interoperability, page mapping, persistence and reset effects

ezflash_synthetic_model.policy: Configured status value other than 0xEEE1 (default 0), no synthetic wait cycles, max four 512-byte sectors per command
ezflash_synthetic_model.tested: Host tests cover SD reads/writes and image bounds; PSRAM page mapping; S71 0x2202 ID/erase/program; S98 128 KiB erase/program; mGBA SD DMA, LDM/STM and ROM backing mirror/restoration
ezflash_synthetic_model.scope: Source-shaped transactions only: status zero, no card latency, zero-initialized PSRAM, distinct S71/S98 flash backing. Physical chip identity/behavior and bus timing UNVERIFIED

common.mode_register: 0x09FFFFFE; write_supercard_mode sends 0xA55A twice followed by mode bits twice
common.mode_bits: bit 0 selects SDRAM versus firmware/flash; bit 1 enables the SD interface; bit 2 controls SDRAM write access
common.boot_fetch: rom_boot.S copies the first 1 KiB from GAMEPAK_BASEADDR 0x08000000 to 0x03800000, then executes the copied bytes; plugin launch writes the plugin/game to GBA_ROM_ADDR 0x08000000 and launches after selecting SDRAM mode
common.evidence_scope: DSSMM Build769 source only; physical card mapping and timing UNVERIFIED

supercard_sd.sd_read: The non-Lite, non-Chis path streams sector data from 0x09100000 or 0x0B100000; writes use 0x09000000 or 0x0B000000
supercard_sd.flash_difference: Internal flash address permutation is applied by flash.c; it does not change the source-described SDRAM mode bit

supercard_lite.sd_data: Reads and writes use 32-bit block port 0x09200000; source comments state the cart clocks data and requires slower waitstates

supercard_chis.sd_data: The conditional read path shares Lite's 0x09200000 block port; writes use the 0x09000000/0x0B000000 serial register path
supercard_chis.flash_difference: rom_boot.S programs eight NOR map entries using three writes (0xA55A twice, then 0x100 | map value); Chis also assigns mode bit 3 to SRAM bank selection

superfw_build769_source_audit.runner_status: A26 runner board is selected with A26_SUPERCARD_BOARD=lite|sd|chis (default lite). Each current 2,000-frame run used the matching Build769 firmware and a separately created fresh 64 MiB FAT32 image containing KERNEL.GBA plus identical plugin/ROM file hashes. Host tests cover SD read port windows/lane packing, SD/Chis serial writes, and the Build769 Chis NOR-map transcript. With the kernel file in the image: SD reported 1 model block, 0 failures, FNV64 30C994B7E348742D; Lite reported 60 model blocks/3,900 data-port reads/0 failures, FNV64 357015EFA2DF90AB; Chis reported 60 model blocks/3,900 data-port reads/0 failures, same FNV64. First traced EWRAM execution is frame 47 on each. These fixed-total-frame hashes are not synchronized game-state comparisons. Separate image SHA-256: SD 8a4d3861e263f698340a661e1c38bfc87fce1c5597633b71baf03e442e61f3b2, Lite 041a776efe8fe91299808a4f00aecd2f3db9a882f9e66b6712e85006f143a53d, Chis af231ad09991c9ef925e2c2acf1bb4161208b49bf7222cba3bc020fd1825842f. Chis NOR/SRAM mappings remain unmodeled because Build769 expectations conflict with pinned CPLD source; board-revision equivalence is UNVERIFIED. Physical card behavior/timing remains UNVERIFIED. Key injection accepts one-frame taps or inclusive frame ranges in the SuperCard runner; this is input tooling only. No new positive PocketNES control result was obtained for Lite/SD in the latest attempts.
